notes: Tested ComfyUI workflow repertoire. Each entry is a proven graph with fixed internal settings; the supervisor only fills the declared parameters. Never invent sampler settings: if a job does not fit an entry, say so instead of improvising a graph.

runtime.server: Local ComfyUI, COMFY_URL env (default http://127.0.0.1:8188), install in E:\ComfyUI (.venv inside; moved off C:\tmp after the system purged the two largest model files there)
runtime.hardware: RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB verified; start with --disable-pinned-memory --reserve-vram 1.5
runtime.diskWarning: Keep several GB free on C: - a full disk silently breaks pagefile growth and jobs fail with CPU allocator errors

workflows.purpose: Replace a person in real footage with a reference character, following the source performance frame by frame (position, trajectory, timing). Scene/background preserved.
pickWhen: user asks to turn a person into another character and the source performance must be followed
Recast (hosted) is unavailable, too loose, or a local/no-cost render is preferred
doNotPickWhen: localised edit only (garment, prop, removal): use the VACE backend instead
no reference character image exists yet: build one first (image generation or edited keyframe)

parameters.DRIVING_FILE: driving clip in ComfyUI/input: 65 frames, 16 fps, generation size (multiple of 32)
parameters.REF_FILE: reference character image in ComfyUI/input, REFRAMED so the character occupies the same frame-height fraction as the source subject (measured from the SAM mask)
parameters.DETECT_SUBJECT: SAM3 detection noun for the source subject, e.g. woman
parameters.DETECT_REF: SAM3 detection noun for the reference, e.g. toy robot
parameters.POSITIVE: description of the FINISHED result (character + action + scene), never an instruction
parameters.WIDTH/HEIGHT: generation size, multiple of 32, source aspect
parameters.LENGTH: 65 (single chunk; longer clips need the Extend chunk, not yet templated)

workflows.fixedSettings: SCAIL-2 int8 model, lightx2v LoRA 0.8, SCAIL DPO LoRA 1.0, shift 5, euler/simple, 6 steps, CFG 1, pose_strength 1, replacement_mode true. Do not tune per request.
workflows.testedResult: 2026-10-30, easy stock clip (woman walking on a hill -> robot reference): identity stable, trajectory followed, background preserved. Known limit: body orientation can drift toward camera vs a strict side-profile source.
workflows.cost: local GPU only, about 6 min for 65 frames at 960x544 on a 4070 Ti

workflows.purpose: Animation Mode of the same SCAIL-2 graph (REPLACEMENT_MODE=false, backend scail-animate): the reference character performs the driving motion, on the reference image's own background. Use to animate a still character with a performance clip.
pickWhen: user wants a character image to move/act like a driving video, keeping the character's own scene
doNotPickWhen: the source footage scene must be preserved: that is Replacement Mode (scail)

parameters.DRIVING_FILE: driving clip in ComfyUI/input: 65 frames, 16 fps, generation size
parameters.REF_FILE: character image cover-scaled to the generation frame (the server does this)
parameters.DETECT_SUBJECT: SAM3 detection noun for the driving subject
parameters.DETECT_REF: SAM3 detection noun for the character
parameters.POSITIVE: description of the FINISHED result, never an instruction

workflows.fixedSettings: Identical to scail2-character-replacement; only REPLACEMENT_MODE differs.
workflows.testedResult: Wiring tested 2026-10-30 (same harness); judge quality per render.
workflows.cost: local GPU only, about 6 min for 65 frames at 960x544 on a 4070 Ti

workflows.purpose: Localised masked video edit: repaint only inside the SAM mask (garment change, prop swap, object/person removal), following the official ComfyUI VACE template pattern at 1.3B for a 12 GB GPU.
pickWhen: the edit is localised and the rest of the frame must stay untouched
a local/no-cost masked edit is preferred over the hosted VACE endpoint
doNotPickWhen: full character replacement: use scail2-character-replacement or Recast
the mask is unreliable: fix tracking first

parameters.CONTROL_FILE: source segment with the masked area filled grey-127 (server builds it from the SAM mask)
parameters.MASK_FILE: mask video at generation size (server builds it)
parameters.REF_FILE: optional design reference; the segment first frame when none is given
parameters.POSITIVE: description of the FINISHED result inside the mask
parameters.MASK_EXPAND: 12 px beyond the server-dilated mask (official template grows 20 at 720p)

workflows.fixedSettings: Wan2.1 VACE 1.3B fp16, WanVaceToVideo strength 1, shift 5, KSampler 8 steps CFG 6 uni_pc/simple denoise 1, seed 42, draft size 832x480 / 65 frames. Do not tune per request. (Official undistilled recipe is 20 steps; measured ~160 s/step on a 4070 Ti at 960x544/81f, hence the draft tier.)
workflows.testedResult: Wiring tested 2026-10-30 on the easy stock clip (draft tier); quality below the 14B hosted endpoint is expected at 1.3B.
workflows.cost: local GPU only, roughly 10 min for 65 frames at 832x480 on a 4070 Ti
